title: Relay agent event poll
description: GET /v1/events 200 response. Relay keeps ONE durable event log per participant. `after` is the last sequence the caller has seen and the page is everything newer, oldest first — a plain pull, not a consumer session: there is no exclusive consumer, no acknowledgement handshake, no reconcile endpoint, and polling works alongside webhooks rather than instead of them. Delivery is at least once, so a caller that sees an event twice ignores it. Passing `timeout` from 1 to 30 holds the request open until something arrives. Handing a page over stamps the messages in it delivered.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `after` on the next poll. Equal to the request's `after` when `events` is empty.

latest.description: The highest sequence Relay has issued to this agent; 0 before its first event.

has_more.description: True when `next_cursor` is behind `latest` — poll again immediately rather than waiting.

AgentEventEnvelope.title: Agent event envelope
AgentEventEnvelope.description: One envelope from this agent's log. A webhook delivers the same event, and the two transports render the envelope for their own consumer: a poll page names its recipient with `agent_id`, and each transport stamps the version its consumer is pinned to.

event_id.description: Deduplicate on this — delivery is at least once.

sequence.description: This agent's position in its own log. Strictly increasing, gap-free, and the value to send back as `after`.

agent_id.description: The recipient, so one handler can serve several agents.

data.description: Per event type, an event's data is the thing itself, where the matching HTTP response wraps it in a named field. message.received: the message, as message-v2.schema.json#/$defs/Message. message.delivered / message.read: { message_id, chat_id, through_sequence, at, recipient, participant }. reaction.added / reaction.removed: the reaction, as { message_id, target_part_id, type, custom_emoji?, actor, operation, changed }. chat.created, chat.group_name_updated, chat.group_icon_updated, participant.added, participant.removed: { chat_id, actor, affected_participant?, membership_version, message }, as group-lifecycle-event.schema.json.

chat_id.description: Null for an event that is not about one conversation.

schema_version.description: The envelope shape this delivery was rendered as, as the date it was frozen. Additive fields never change it. Webhook deliveries carry their endpoint's pinned value in the relay-webhook-version header and in this field.
